test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 29 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which landmark treaty, aimed at protecting the high seas, achieved its final ratification push during the UN Ocean Conference in June 2025?

options.text: United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS)

solution:
The correct answer is __**Biodiversity Beyond National Jurisdiction (BBNJ) Agreement**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Biodiversity Beyond National Jurisdiction (BBNJ) Agreement**, often referred to as the **"High Seas Treaty,"** is a landmark international legally binding instrument under the **United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS)**.
 
• The treaty achieved its critical final ratification push during the **UN Ocean Conference** held in **June 2025** in **Nice, France**. This conference served as a global platform to urge member states to reach the **60-ratification** threshold required for the treaty to enter into force.
 
• The primary objective of the **BBNJ Agreement** is the **conservation and sustainable use** of marine biological diversity in areas beyond national jurisdiction, which cover nearly **two-thirds** of the global ocean and **95%** of its volume.
 
• It is a vital component for achieving the **"30x30" target**, an international commitment to protect **30% of the world's land and oceans by the year 2030**, as established under the **Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework**.
 
• T
